en.details:
Dear Metas,

We have scheduled server maintenance and an update for September 28, 2026, at 4:00 PM (PT). The maintenance is expected to last about 2 hour (The actual server opening time may differ). Please manage your time wisely.

This update brings: the Limited-time Events & , new Custom Dye Sets, free Character Customization and Hairstyle Dye, territory Animal Targeted Breeding feature, Golden Autumn Cumulative Top-up Rewards, Lightforge Loot Crate autumn return, and more, along with recent bug fixes.

After this maintenance is complete, we will distribute maintenance rewards: Starchrom ×1000, Mitsuko's Mark ×100, Stardust Secret Crate·S14 (Epic) ×1, Dog Selection Crate ×1! Use the Dog Selection Crate to choose 1 of 3 limited Deviations: Labrador, Blackback, or Doberman (Deviation Level and Stability Level 3). Participate in the event to also obtain a dog Deviation with Deviation Level and Stability Level 5! Metas, don't miss out. …
